subject: store: make storage type a enum (#57276)
summary: Introduces `config.StoreType` (string enum) for configured storage backend selection and updates in-scope call sites to compare against typed constants. Store driver registration/lookup in `pkg/store` now keys by `StoreType` and rejects invalid types; BRIE gating, txn retry behavior for UniStore, and sysvar initial defaults switch from raw string literals to `StoreType` constants. No Blocker/High issues found in the specified scope; later upstream/master history shows no follow-up fix specifically correcting this change within the reviewed scope.
